Mudbray

Ground

Alola · Generation 7

Mudbray is a Ground-type Donkey Pokémon first found in Alola (Generation 7). It stands 1 m tall and weighs 110 kg. It evolves into Mudsdale. Its highest base stat is Attack (100), with a base stat total of 385.
